author: Brodie Robertson | Linux Tips & Tricks
description:
I never expected to see drama in the FOSS document editor space, but out of nowhere 2 things are happening around the same time, NextCloud with there new EuroOffice vs OnlyOffice and The Document Foundation with LibreOffice vs Collabora with the Collabora Productivity.
